usageNotes: Use this to enable or configure firewall enforcement on a specific SDN vnet, including setting the default forward policy (ACCEPT or DROP) and log verbosity for forwarded traffic. The caller must hold SDN.Allocate on the vnet's zone path ('/sdn/zones/<zone>/<vnet>'); changes take effect after the cluster SDN config is applied via 'put_cluster_sdn_reload'. Pass 'digest' from a prior GET to guard against concurrent edits overwriting each other.

examples.summary: Enable firewall with DROP forward policy and info-level logging on vnet 'prod01'

tips: Firewall changes on a vnet are not live until SDN is reloaded cluster-wide; call put_cluster_sdn_reload after this.
The default 'enable' value is 0 (disabled); traffic is not filtered until explicitly enabled.
Use the 'delete' param to reset specific options (e.g., 'log_level_forward') back to defaults rather than sending an empty string.
Retrieve the current digest with get_cluster_sdn_vnets_vnet_firewall_options before writing to prevent race conditions in automated workflows.
